Krishna is the eighth avatar of the god Vishnu in Hinduism and is often depicted as the god of love, compassion, and mischief. He is also known as the Moon God, and hence the name "Furkhan," which means "Lord of the Moon," holds immense spiritual relevance to Krishna's deity. This name invokes a sense of reverence, devotion, and spiritual connection to the Hindu god Krishna.
